name: Xiaohongshu creator center

guide.zh: 上传页默认是「上传视频」。视频传完后标题、正文会自动填好；封面请点「设置封面」自己选（可用「在访达中显示封面」）。最后由你点「发布」。
guide.en: The page opens on "Upload video". Title and text are filled once the video is uploading; pick the cover yourself under "Set cover" ("Show cover in Finder" helps). You press Publish.

zh: 设置封面（自定义封面需你点开上传）
话题：输入 # 后从列表中选，正文里的 #标签 只是文字
内容类型声明 / AI 生成声明
en: Topics: type # and pick from the list - the #tags in the text stay plain text

disclosure.zh: 如内容含 AI 生成画面/声音，请在发布页勾选「内容含 AI 生成」类声明（以平台当前选项为准）。标题 ≤ 20 字（英文/数字按半个字算）。
disclosure.en: If the post contains AI-generated images or audio, tick the platform's AI-content declaration on the publish page. Title max 20 characters (latin letters and digits count half).

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors, written without a logged-in session: role / text selectors with fallbacks. Tune them from a 'Capture this page' snapshot (Publish -> the browser's ... menu) and set status to verified + lastVerified.
The title / text fields appear after the video starts uploading: the fill waits up to 120 s for them.
Custom cover upload needs a click on 设置封面 (the app never clicks), so the cover is left to her.
